k0_test.rule: no square is BOTH axis-aligned (|theta - k*pi/2| <= 1e-6 rad) AND centred within 1e-6 (L_inf) of a corner slot (1/2,1/2),(s-1/2,1/2),(1/2,s-1/2),(s-1/2,s-1/2)
k0_test.stricter_count: n_axis_aligned = number of axis-aligned squares at all

optimiser: A04 driver.local_opt (penalty continuation mu=10..1e8, SLSQP polish on the active contact structure, inflate to strict feasibility) transcribed into code/cp85.py; k0-forced variant adds a Gaussian corner-slot repulsion during the penalty phase only, then re-relaxes with lam = 0

headline.caveat: the operational k=0 test at tol 1e-6 is passed by configurations whose axis-aligned corner square sits only ~1e-3 from the flush slot; read the ladder, not the single 1e-6 number.  'NEW_below_3.9' in the per-optimum classification means only 'outside every A37 certified box' (boxes have h ~ 4e-3 .. 6e-2), not 'not a known family' -- use nearest_catalogue for that.

contact_counts.note: A genuine rigid 11-square CP carries ~14 pair + ~20 wall rows (Trump). Every k0 landing here is far under-contacted, i.e. a shallow valley/rattler point, not a rigid critical point.
